## Description
Describe your changes and provide context for why they are needed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Content correction (Japanese curriculum, vocabulary, or grammar)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Backend lint and tests pass (`ruff check app tests migrations`, `pytest`)
- [ ] Frontend lint, typecheck, tests, and build pass (`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx vitest run`, `npm run build`)
- [ ] Verified unrestricted study: no locks, cooldowns, or lives added.
- [ ] Any schema changes include tested forward Alembic migrations.

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] Existing documentation has been updated where applicable.
